reviewers.summary: The publish job is gated to main pushes and captures and uploads the registry digest separately. It does not add that digest to the existing supply-chain-evidence artifact as required by AC: IMAGE-BUILD-03.

findingList.message: The digest is not included in the existing supply-chain-evidence artifact. Transfer it into that artifact or publish the evidence artifact after the digest is available.

evidence.codePathTraced: build-and-gate uploads the supply-chain-evidence artifact before the separate publish-image job runs. publish-image writes the digest in its own job workspace and uploads it only as image-digest.
evidence.failureScenario: After a successful main push, a consumer downloads supply-chain-evidence and finds no artifacts/image/digest.txt, despite AC: IMAGE-BUILD-03 requiring that artifact to contain the digest.

reviewers.summary: The publish job is gated to main pushes and records a registry-produced digest in a separate artifact. It does not include that digest in the existing supply-chain-evidence artifact as required by AC: IMAGE-BUILD-03.

findingList.message: AC: IMAGE-BUILD-03 is incomplete: the digest is not added to the existing supply-chain-evidence artifact, and the named test does not assert that requirement.

evidence.codePathTraced: The build-and-gate job uploads supply-chain-evidence before publish-image runs. publish-image writes the digest in its own job and uploads only image-digest.
evidence.failureScenario: After a successful main push, a consumer downloads supply-chain-evidence and finds no image digest, despite AC: IMAGE-BUILD-03 requiring the digest in that artifact. The named artifact test checks only the separate image-digest upload, so it would pass.

reviewers.summary: The workflow publishes the digest separately but does not add it to the existing supply-chain-evidence artifact. That leaves consumers of the evidence artifact unable to associate it with the published image.

findingList.message: The digest is not included in the existing supply-chain-evidence artifact as AC IMAGE-BUILD-03 requires. The publish job's file is isolated from the artifact already uploaded by build-and-gate; only the separate image-digest artifact receives it. This breaks the evidence-to-image integrity link (A08:2025).

evidence.codePathTraced: The digest is written in the publish-image job and uploaded as the separate image-digest artifact. The supply-chain-evidence artifact is uploaded by build-and-gate, a different job.
evidence.failureScenario: After a successful push, a consumer downloads supply-chain-evidence to verify the published image but finds no digest in it, so the image cannot be linked to that evidence artifact.
